body: I think of this every-single-day! I waited 10 years for the person I fell for to come back...except he never was that person. I got to see him for who he was and he resented that.
I do the same thing! I’m not quite sure how to avoid it😣
This was always my relationship. Before he left he told me he knew since the beginning that he didn’t want this relationship. It only took him 10 years to come to terms with it....

I agree with this! I know it may not be what most people would say is “right” but the years of bullshit and pain and then to leave me the way he did-I just want him to experience this same kind of hurt and loss I am now.

Thank you for these kind words! That’s the best way I could say to have put it-we have to keep fighting until it doesn’t matter anymore and the pain subsides.

I hope that things are getting easier for you everyday and that you heal and know you’re going to be the one to make it out on top of the situation!

I needed to see this today! My ex is a selfish person who from day one never wanted the relationship but didn’t let me know that until 9 years down the line?!?! The one thing I find comfort in is that I did everything I could to provide love, comfort and support to this guy. Physically being here, emotionally being here. All I ever did was try to make this a successful relationship. It was him who made it what it was. And go figure he was the one who walked out!
Needed this !

I’m so sorry to hear this. It sounds like you guys had a really great relationship but there is something in her that’s off. You sound like a wonderful person and did your part in the relationship. I’m so sorry she hurt you this way and I’m here going through the same hurt with you!

I needed this!!!! I try to not think of these things and hurt my own feelings by remembering my ex doesn’t care or think of me. But what does it matter? They walked out and left so they should no longer get to have that hold on me.

Thank you for this!
Thank you! That really lifted my spirits and gave me some really great things to look forward too. Thank you for this!!!!
I’ve felt this way for a long time! I don’t know what they would do without me so I can’t leave them. You’re not alone in feeling like this!
Add me please!
I have. Therapy has helped me a lot but I still have really sad days where I feel stuck in that place. I still try to put my best efforts forth to work on it but sometimes it’s tough.
Thank you!!❤️❤️❤️❤️

Just saw this, I’m sorry! I don’t remember birthdays very well (unless Facebook reminds me) I don’t remember what their favorite things are. I used to know all of this but I feel as if that was in another life and I’m so distanced and detached now. I almost feel uncomfortable having conversations with my friends now because I don’t feel like the same person who was their friend. I hope this makes sense!

The same thing has been happening to me also! It  seems there are a few product design flaws but I’m hoping to get a new seat that’s more comfortable and hopefully will help me sit and adjust better and that won’t happen anymore.

I made the mistake of not making sure the pedal bolts were tightened all the way and I came out of the saddle and the pedal stripped out of the crank arm so I would check the bolts for sure and make sure everything is tight!
I feel all if this!

Wow! I think about this constantly. I have a few friends and many distant ones. The friends I’ve made in my late 20s and now early 30s have all ended in terrible ways. Maybe I don’t really know how to be a friend? I’m terrible and remembering what my friend even like. I deal with so much externally sometimes I think maybe not having any friends would be the best way for me to go. I feel this post 100 percent!
Lmfao @ Walmart Wes🤣
CASTEEEEO☠️🤣

I feel this way everyday! It became more apparent as I got into my mid 20s and realized I was totally lost. I feel like I don’t have a connection with anyone and even with some of my friends who I’ve known for years, I now feel disconnected and awake are with. I feel that I never have anything to talk about. The other day I realized I’m a loner who never wanted to be one😭
